select name, heat from oj_course

select oj_course_category.resource_id, oj_course_category.name as name,ifnull(sum(oj_course.heat),0) as description from oj_course_category left join oj_course on oj_course.category_id = oj_course_category.resource_id
group by oj_course_category.resource_id
